newsitem.title: JAPAN: Improper to manage money policy only for forex-BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Improper to manage money policy only for forex-BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Wednesday that it would be improper to manage monetary policy only to achieve stability in foreign exchange rates and correct current account imbalances.
He made the remarks at a parliamentary committee meeting.

"It is important for the BOJ to manage its monetary policy to prevent inflation, and therefore it is improper for it to conduct its policy in response to currency moves and to redress the imbalances in the country's current account," he said.
